svg.title: Shallow copy and deep copy
svg.desc: Two panels, after grid[0][0] = 1. Tag 1: grid and shallow are two different outer lists, but the slots of both refer to the same two inner lists, [1, 0] and [0, 0], so the change shows through shallow. Tag 2: deep is an outer list whose slots refer to its own two inner lists, both still [0, 0].
